verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents an official RevenueCat MCP server that lets AI assistants manage subscription apps, Products, Entitlements, and related configuration without the dashboard, so an agent can connect to it directly. The AI Toolkit for coding agents reinforces this agent-facing integration. Missing for 10: setup and authentication details for connecting an agent to the MCP server, the list of supported MCP clients or transports, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The RevenueCat MCP (Model Context Protocol) server enables AI assistants to manage subscription apps, Products, Entitlements, and everything in-between without using the RevenueCat dashboard.
The RevenueCat AI Toolkit is what you install so your own coding agent can work with RevenueCat.
